instruction.text: Complete the sentence with the correct reflexive pronoun.

wrong.text:
Reflexive pronouns refer back to the person or thing doing the action.

Here are some examples:

Tim washes himself.
We helped ourselves.
You should behave yourself.

atoms.b: I hurt ((++myself herself)) in PE today.
atoms.finishSound: I hurt myself in PE today.

atoms.b: Callum enjoyed ((++himself myself)) at the fair.
atoms.finishSound: Callum enjoyed himself at the fair.

atoms.b: Samira and Dominic treated ((++themselves itself)) to something tasty.
atoms.finishSound: Samira and Dominic treated themselves to something tasty.
